candidates: When the CLI AST-transform layer (e.g., `eslintPlugin.ts`) matches a `CallExpression` by its callee identifier name, always resolve the identifier back to its `ImportDeclaration` and verify it originates from the expected source package before mutating the AST. Tracking only the local binding name is insufficient — a user config may import an identically-named function from a different package, which must be left untouched.
